target.strategy: strict integration with a validated Windows CNG module

embedded_evidence.scope_limit: Evidence applies only under the certificate and Security Policy; it is not an EntropyForge certificate.

fips_140_3_dependency.module_family: Microsoft Windows Cryptographic Primitives Library for Windows 11 23H2/24H2

prohibited_claims: EntropyForge is a certified physical or hardware RNG
external_actions_required: Freeze a supported Windows build and hardware scope
Select and contract an NVLAP-accredited laboratory
Confirm the underlying module certificate and Security Policy
Complete vendor evidence and operational testing
Submit through the laboratory and receive an issued certificate before making a certification claim
